Talk at OOP 2011

Johannes Bohnet, member of the CGS group, gave a talk on "Dynamic Analysis, Tracing, and Reverse Debugging - Potential, Best Practices, and Tools" at the major conference on software engineering in Germany, "OOP 2011 - Business Impact through Mastering Change", which was located in Munich from 24. until 28. Jan 2011.
